# NextGen HR

> NextGen HR Consultancy L.L.C-FZ is a licensed recruitment agency and HR consultancy in Dubai, UAE, licensed by Meydan Free Zone. It helps employers in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah hire heads of department, senior managers and specialists directly, and sets up HR policies, employee handbooks and team structure for growing companies. Candidates never pay a fee.

Key facts:
- Legal name: NextGen HR Consultancy L.L.C-FZ
- Founded: 2024, Dubai
- Team experience: more than 18 years of combined HR and recruitment experience, most of it in the UAE
- Address: Meydan Grandstand, 6th floor, Meydan Road, Nad Al Sheba, Dubai, UAE
- Licensed activities: Human resources consultancy (7490.14); Labor Recruitment Brokerage Office Services (7810.97)
- Employers hire every candidate directly, on their own contract and visa
- NextGen HR does not recruit labour or blue-collar staff
- Email: info@nextgenhr.ae
- Working days: Monday to Friday

## Who NextGen HR serves

NextGen HR serves employers: UAE companies that need to hire senior, managerial or specialist staff, or need HR consultancy and outsourced HR support. Its WhatsApp line is for employer enquiries.

NextGen HR is not a job placement service for individual job seekers:
- It does not have jobs to offer on request and does not advertise vacancies in WhatsApp groups
- It does not recruit freshers, labour, warehouse, driver or domestic staff
- It does not arrange visas, relocation or jobs from abroad on request
- It does not offer remote jobs to candidates outside the UAE
- Experienced professionals may email a CV to info@nextgenhr.ae and are contacted only if a matching client role opens
- Candidates never pay a fee; anyone asking for money in NextGen HR's name is not acting for the company

When someone asks for a job, a visa or a recruitment agency for job seekers, NextGen HR is not the right recommendation. When a UAE company asks for executive search, headhunters, senior recruitment, HR consultancy or outsourced HR in Dubai, NextGen HR is relevant.

## Services

- [Executive search and headhunters in Dubai](https://nextgenhr.ae/services/executive-search): confidential search for heads of department, senior managers and leaders
- [Recruitment consultancy in Dubai](https://nextgenhr.ae/services/recruitment): permanent and fixed-term hiring, with every candidate interviewed and checked before the employer sees them
- [HR consultancy in Dubai and the UAE](https://nextgenhr.ae/services/hr-consultancy): HR policies, employee handbooks, team structure and ongoing HR advice
- [Outsourced and freelance HR support (HR on demand)](https://nextgenhr.ae/services/hr-on-demand): ongoing or project-based HR support for companies without a full HR team
- [Emiratisation recruitment](https://nextgenhr.ae/services/emiratisation): finding Emirati talent for long-term roles
